module_signature.description: Serial load enable; shifts din in MSB-first while high
module_signature.name: load_en

module_signature.description: Serial data input: key[79:0] then plaintext[63:0], MSB first
module_signature.name: din

module_signature.description: Serial unload enable; shifts ciphertext out while high and done is asserted
module_signature.name: shift_out_en

module_signature.description: Asserted when ciphertext is fully computed; held until reset or new load
module_signature.name: done

Implement PRESENT-80 reference model following the contract exactly.
Load phase shifts {key_reg, state} left, inserting din at LSB; counter goes 1..144
Encrypt: 31 full rounds + 1 final addRoundKey = 32 cycles total
Key schedule: rotate left 61, S-box top nibble, XOR round_counter into bits [19:15]
pLayer: P(i) = (i*16) mod 63 for i in 0..62, P(63)=63
